classes.NUMERICS_LIMITED: A declared-numerics limitation: the physics answer at theta is not established (root outside a declared bracket, search limit, iteration or pass budget, float resolution). purpose: Classify every terminal outcome of one forward call of driver c2v008 into exactly one class. The orchestrator c2v004 loads THIS file (pinned by sha256 in its config) and evaluates the ordered rules on (driver status, driver reasons, result.route_a_outcome, the route-A checkpoint records, the stage records and the Picard pass history of the call directory); never on status alone. The first matching rule wins; anything unmatched is the default class INFRA. Changes from V001: retarget to the c2v008 status vocabulary (ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT is its own status since c2v007); CHECK_SCIENCE_V001 C1 (R01 requires the declared Picard bound to be met; new R03), C2 (R10 defaults to NUMERICS_LIMITED; MODEL_INVALID only under a root-declared contraction test), C3 (R30 is a judgment call whenever a bound is declared; per-pass history recorded), C6 (R31 -> INFRA), C10 ('relaxed gas: nonfinite' in R13); new R15 (parallel route-A pool failure) and R39 (stage-binding geometry gap). Changes from V002 (CHECK_SCIENCE_V001 of orchestrator c2v003): S1 R30 under a declared Picard bound is MODEL_INVALID only when no recorded pass produced positive rotation; an earlier positive pass makes it NUMERICS_LIMITED FINAL_PICARD_ITERATE_NONPOSITIVE_UNCONVERGED (HALT for root, pass history in the detail); an unreadable pass history is INFRA FINAL_PASS_NONPOSITIVE_PASS_HISTORY_UNREADABLE. S2 the root-declared contraction test needs threshold >= 1. F1 (CHECK_SOFTWARE_V001) adds the finish.json -> result binding to the orchestrator-level checks. Nothing else changed.

route_a_contraction_test.status: ROOT-DECLARED ONLY (config field route_a_contraction_test; null = not declared). Without a declaration R10 is NUMERICS_LIMITED.

LAST_RATIOS_AT_LEAST.evaluation: ratios q_i = r_i / r_(i-1) of the gas Fourier residual over the completed iterations 0..max_iterations-1 (all present, contiguous, bound to the checkpoint identity); NON_CONTRACTING iff the last n_last ratios are all >= threshold -> MODEL_INVALID ROUTE_A_NON_CONTRACTING_WITHIN_MAX_ITERATIONS; otherwise CONTRACTING -> NUMERICS_LIMITED ROUTE_A_ITERATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_CONTRACTING. The residual history, the ratios and the verdict are recorded in the classification detail (bound into the cache entry and re-derived on every open).

parameters.judgment_call: bool (root states whether a MODEL_INVALID from this test counts as a judgment call for D5)
parameters.threshold: finite float >= 1 (V003, CHECK_SCIENCE_V001 S2: a residual ratio below 1 is contraction by definition)
